title: Essex Gas Company d/b/a KeySpan energy Delivery New England files for review and approval, pursuant to G.L. c. 164, § 94 and 220 CMR 5.03, a 244-Day Firm Transportation Agreement with Brox Industries.
petitioner: Essex Gas Company D/B/A National Grid
filings: The Department Approves the proposed Agreement. The Department finds that the pricing terms of the Agreement are competitively sensitive, and therefore Grants the Company's request for protection from public disclosure. Commissioners participating were: James Connelly, Chairman; Commissioners w. Robert Keating, Paul B. Vasington, Eugene J. Sullivan, Jr., and Deirdre K. Manning. (GC 02-08)
